name: Kikushita Yuumi
source:
Subaru's homeroom teacher, Yuumi specialises in Japanese studies. Well-proportioned with an excellent sense of style, Yuumi seems mature and calm at a first glance. Though she is prone to extreme assumptions, she is well-received by her students. She is very popular amongst the male student body. Yuumi is single, and currently in an unrequited love.

[Taken from the [url=http://nekomarudow.com/y/]official website[/url]]
